entries.source: No one has more friends than me!
entries.proposed: Ninguém tem mais amigos do que eu!

entries.source: I have tons of friends!
entries.proposed: Tenho um monte de amigos!

entries.source: Make lots of friends by battling a bunch!
entries.proposed: Faça muitos amigos batalhando bastante!

entries.source: I'm not sad! I just made a new friend.
entries.proposed: Não estou triste! Fiz uma nova amizade.

entries.source: Let's be friends!
entries.proposed: Vamos ser amigos!

entries.source: Yeah! We're friends from now on!
entries.proposed: Isso! Agora somos amigos!

entries.source: You're my rival, not my friend!
entries.proposed: Você é meu rival, não meu amigo!

entries.source: My love will never die!
entries.proposed: Meu amor nunca vai morrer!

entries.source: Did you see that? The power of love!
entries.proposed: Viu só? É o poder do amor!

entries.source: Even though I lost, I still love them!
entries.proposed: Mesmo perdendo, ainda amo todos eles!

entries.source: Come, sandstorm!
entries.proposed: Venha, tempestade de areia!

entries.source: It's a storm of wins wherever I go!
entries.proposed: Por onde eu passo, chovem vitórias!

entries.source: I don't want to hear a storm of boos!
entries.proposed: Não quero ouvir uma tempestade de vaias!

entries.source: Come, hail!
entries.proposed: Venha, granizo!

entries.source: What? That's it? That's all you got?
entries.proposed: O quê? Só isso? É só isso que você tem?

entries.source: Crushed by a total defeat!
entries.proposed: Uma derrota esmagadora!

entries.source: Come, rain!
entries.proposed: Venha, chuva!

entries.source: The rain was a blessing for me!
entries.proposed: A chuva foi uma bênção para mim!

entries.source: It's pouring rain inside my heart...
entries.proposed: Chove forte dentro do meu coração...

entries.source: I hope it'll be sunny!
entries.proposed: Tomara que faça sol!
